item.text: 我会读取 inputs 中的 probe.txt，并尝试读取 missing-probe.txt 一次，然后生成两个交付文件。

item.command:
"<user-home>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$sourcePath = Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'inputs/probe.txt'
"'$outputDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'outputs'
[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory("'$outputDir) | Out-Null
[System.IO.File]::Copy($sourcePath, (Join-Path $outputDir '"'echo.txt'), "'$true)
$sourceText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($sourcePath, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
$firstLine = $sourceText.Split([char]10)[0]
$receipt = [ordered]@{ source_file = '"'probe.txt'; token = "'$firstLine.Substring(6); missing_file = '"'missing-probe.txt'; missing_status = 'not_found' }
"'$json = ($receipt | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) + "`n"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $outputDir '"'receipt.json'), "'$json, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))'
